# esp-web-tools (vendored)

`esp-web-tools` 10.4.0, Apache-2.0. Copied from the npm package
(`esp-web-tools@10.4.0/dist/web`) so the flasher does not depend on
`unpkg.com`, which is unreachable on some networks (the same reason the
device's OTA list has mirrors).

Upgrade by replacing this directory with `dist/web` from a newer package and
updating this note. Keep `LICENSE` next to the files.
